synopsis: The story revolves around the lives of two rough-and-tumble high school friends, Hiroshi Kato and Toru Nakama, who frequently cause trouble and start fights. In keeping with the spirit of the manga, Toru and Hiroshi style their hair in punch perms and also adopt exaggerated swaggering gaits. The manga also features an assortment of outlandish characters who also sport unusual fashions and hairdos. (Source: Wikipedia) Note: Won the 12th Kodansha Manga Award for general manga in 1988.

title: Aoi Honoo
synopsis: In this story set in the early 1980s, a young man dreams of becoming a renowned comic writer in years to come. His name is HONOO Moyuru. He has no money, only a dream. Then, he feels overwhelmed by his lack of ability, and buys some sake, although he has no head or stomach for alcohol. This is a tortured elegy for any dashing young art student who spends his days careening around in burning ambition.

title: Ano Ko wa Kishi
synopsis: ​Shori Himesaki has always had recurring dreams of a medieval world where a valiant knight protects a beautiful princess. He's spent his life idly assuming that he must have been the knight in a past life. ​But that all changed at his high school entrance ceremony. The moment he lays eyes on Asako Kishi, the truth hits him: his past life wasn't the knight's at all. ​He was the princess... and she was the one sworn to protect him. (Source: Sunday Webry, translated) Note: Originally a one-shot. It was later picked up for serialization on Sunday Webry on July 30, 2025. The one-shot was reused as the first chapter for serialized version.

title: Hyang-Dan Dyeon
synopsis: Job seeker Yu Hyang-Gi, struggling day by day, one day finds herself possessed by Hyang-Dan, the character from the traditional Korean folktale Chunhyangjeon. A supporting character, not even the heroine? How wonderful! Our beautiful young lady Chunhyang, and even a madam who cares for her like her own daughter. Hyang-Dan, who only felt the warmth of family after being possessed by the novel, was enjoying a peaceful life. Until "him" showed up! The world's ultimate villain, Byun Hak-Do, is destined to harass Chunhyang and be executed by the male protagonist, Lee Mong-Ryong. How dare he look down on our Chunhyang! "I don't know who you are, but you're a brat." "I've been waiting." "That's why I'm offering you this. An honor no one else can attain." But why do you keep entangling yourself with me? Why does that man care more about me than Chunhyang? A romantic fantasy about Hyang-Dan and Byeon Hak-Do, a twist on classic novels, Hyangdan's Tale. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)
